sn45.91:1.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā ||
sn45.91:1.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || ||
sn45.91:1.4: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || || 3.
sn45.91:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la-pe || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmim || ||
sn45.91:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- amaggam bhāvento a- a- bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti || || 2.
